featured_reviews.name: Burjiz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Chinese Palace is one of the older Chinese restaurants in Mumbai, reportedly around since 1972. The location, however, can be slightly tricky to find, as it is situated on the second floor of a building and set a bit inside from the main road.

We visited as a large group of over 10 people for dinner, which gave us a good opportunity to sample a range of dishes from their extensive menu.

For starters, we ordered Crispy Thai Chicken and Crackling Spinach with Chicken, along with Sweet Corn Chicken Soup. For the mains, we went with Chicken Schezwan Fried Rice, Diced Chicken Chilli, and Stewed Wantons.

The food overall was tasty, though somewhat inconsistent across dishes. The soup was good, and among the starters, both the Crispy Thai Chicken and Crackling Spinach with Chicken stood out as particularly enjoyable. However, some items like the stewed wantons and the diced chicken chilli felt a bit on the blander side, and even the Schezwan fried rice lacked the expected punch.

Portions were generous, which worked well for a group setting. They also serve kimchi as a salad accompaniment, which was a slightly unusual but interesting touch.

Service was good in terms of staff behavior, but the preparation and delivery of food did take time, especially noticeable with a larger group.

Overall, Chinese Palace offers decent food with some standout dishes, but also a fair bit of inconsistency. Worth a visit for select items, but with a bit of patience required.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Chung Fa Chinese Restaurant is a place I’ve visited a number of times over the past few years, and it has consistently delivered a satisfying Indo-Chinese dining experience in Mumbai.

On my most recent visit, we ordered the Chicken Manchow soup, chicken crispy, and fried wantons for starters.

The soup was flavourful and well-prepared, setting a good tone for the meal. The chicken crispy also stood out as one of the better dishes that was nicely done and enjoyable. The fried wantons, however, were just about average in comparison.

Overall, both the starters and the main dishes were tasty and met expectations.

The kitchen does take a bit of time with preparation, but the quality of the food makes the wait worthwhile.

Service has generally been good, attentive and efficient without being intrusive, which adds to the overall comfort of the dining experience.

One area where the restaurant is somewhat limited is desserts. The options are minimal, and typically consist of packaged ice cream cups rather than freshly prepared items.

All things considered, Chung Fa remains a dependable choice for Indo-Chinese cuisine in the Tardeo area. It’s a place I’ve enjoyed returning to over time, and one I would recommend for a satisfying and familiar dining experience.

Opens at morning 6 AM, very good option for breakfast which includes ban Maska pav and kheema paav. Even sandwiches are available. Both veg n non-vegetarian Thali available. Other main course dishes are also delicious. But not authenticated Iranian cuisine. Parcel facility is available. As it's on main Pedder Road, parking is not available.

featured_reviews.name: Aashay Paradkar
featured_reviews.review_text: The only parsi eatery where you can get indian, chinese, mughlai cuisine at moderate price. There are no budget friendly restaurant in such posh area, so this place is popular among office crowd and collage students. Staff and owner was polite. I tried chicken kheema paav, chicken seekh kabab along with chicken biryani. Food quality and quantity was superb but the biryani was little sweet also there was only one big piece of chicken in biryani. Not recommended for vegetarian as they don't have much options.

featured_reviews.name: Chandrachur Chakravarti
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the oldest Persian eateries in Peddar Road, near Jaslok Hospital. Various food items right from fast foods like- Burger, Sandwich,Misal Pav, Bun Maska (Special attraction) to Biriyani, Chinese Items, Tandoori Chicken, Keema, Custard, Lassi, Special Iranian Tea etc. are available. Items are reasonably priced & the joint has a small in house eating area. Menu is different of Breakfast, Lunch, Snacks & Dinner. Must try once & you will love the food and ambience.

featured_reviews.name: Brijesh Trivedi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this restaurant on my wife's birthday, drawn in by its great ambience and inviting atmosphere. The decor and setting were well thought out, making for an enjoyable dining environment.

We ordered a couple of starters, sushi, and a main dish. While the starters were flavorful, the quantity did not justify the price, leaving us feeling that the portions could have been more generous. The real disappointment came when we discovered a long hair in our sushi. This instantly raised concerns about the quality and hygiene of the food.

When we pointed this out to the staff, they handled the situation politely and professionally, taking the dish away and offering us a replacement. While this was appreciated, the incident had already dampened our experience, and we chose to simply request the bill instead.

Surprisingly, the bill still included charges for the sushi as well as service charges. Upon bringing this to their attention, the staff quickly removed those charges. However, they should not have been added in the first place, given the situation.

One positive takeaway was the politeness and courteousness of the staff, who handled the issue without hesitation. Despite this, the combination of portion concerns and an unfortunate hygiene lapse made this an experience we wouldn't eagerly return for.

featured_reviews.name: Anish Karkera
featured_reviews.review_text:
We were just waiting to go here for a long time(years). And the experience was good. The garlic chilli pork ribs were awesome, pairs well with the sauces they give.
The chicken sui mai was a waste, don't order, it has no taste what so ever.
The Mongolian pork recommended by our server was top class delicious. We had it with the lings special fried rice that comes with chicken and shittake mushooms, this was also pretty damn good.
We were worried about the service being bad after looking at the reviews but everyone was super sweet to us, it's also important to note that we went on a Monday. Must be different on other days.
The prices are definitely on a higher end but the rice quantity was really good.
We're definitely going back this was totally worth it.

featured_reviews.name: A Ramadurai
featured_reviews.review_text:
The best Indo Chinese food in Mumbai in my opinion.

Last time we ate here was in 1993 and the bill was nearly Rs 3000 for 6 people

And now yesterday, we ate again to our hearts delight and the bill was Rs. 7555 for 4 people and this included alcohol too.

Hardly any price rise if you consider 3 decades difference.

The food was just superb.

Don't try to book table online, just turn up around 8pm and politely request the owner at the reception for a table and you get something very quickly.

featured_reviews.name: Shounak Nayak
featured_reviews.review_text: Hands down my favourite Chinese restaurant. The steamed wontons are absolutely unreal — easily the highlight every single time. The menu is insanely extensive, so one visit is never enough. Every time you go, there’s something new worth trying. Great food, great flavours, and the kind of place you keep coming back to.

featured_reviews.name: ivana edwards
featured_reviews.review_text:
My favvvv place. It's a no-brainer when I cant decide where to eat out. Hands down the best chinese food in all of India. Been here a zillion times. Never dissapoints

My favs:
Beef Mongolian
Roast Pork Chilly Garlic

Best best best.

featured_reviews.name: Tarasangeeta Upadhyaya
featured_reviews.review_text: Nostalgia trip down memory lane- went there after almost 30 years! The place does not seem to have changed at all. Service is quick and good- our waiter neither wrote anything down, nor used a tablet and yet managed to remember everything!! Starters were fried corn curd- like a sweet corn soup but in solid form-wouldn’t order again, sesame chicken- surprisingly very good and the dim sum platter which they kindly made entirely in chicken. Two large chicken baos, two gyozas and two sui mai were enough for 4 people. The soup was shared by two people and was generously large. We should have stopped at this but greedily ordered chicken fried rice, noodles, Mongolian chicken ( like in a Manchurian sauce) and chilli chicken. All good. Doggie bags taken home!!

featured_reviews.name: SRP
featured_reviews.review_text:
First - if you are expecting Hakka (Indian style Chinese) dishes, you may be disappointed. These are close to real Chinese food - most dishes even if mentioned spicy they are not overly spicy as Hakka dishes.

Our first time trying the Vegan Corn Curd - almost like soft silken tofu consistency. The Spicy ones were really good. The Vegan Fried Wontons and Vegan Spinach were OK. The Spinach lacked sesame seeds/oil flavour. Wontons were a bit too much doughy and less filling.

After having so many starters/appetizers, not enough space for mains. The Vegan Buddha’s Delight was better. Lots of veggies and went well with steamed rice. The Vegan Steamed Buns were a good surprise for us as we don’t normally see this in India. Well made and went well the delight as well.

featured_reviews.name: siddhi nigvekar
featured_reviews.review_text: Ive been here 4 times and I will keep coming back for more. Place is huge and barely has any queue. On Weekends, kindly reserve first. Food is great. Lots of Variety. Service is a bit slow but It could be the weekend rush.

featured_reviews.name: EatWithGad
featured_reviews.review_text: Ling's Pavilion remains the gold standard for authentic Chinese in Mumbai. We had the legendary Stir-fried Bacon with Chili and the Chimney Soup, and both were exceptional. You can really taste the 'Wok Hei' in their dishes. It’s a far cry from typical 'Indo-Chinese'—this is the real deal. Don't leave without trying the Honey Noodles with Ice Cream for dessert. A solid 5-star experience every time

featured_reviews.name: Darrell Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently dined at Stir Fry in The Gordon House, and it was an absolute delight for the palate. The menu offers a beautiful balance of bold flavors and refined textures, and every dish we tried was spot on.

We started with the Mushroom & Cheese Dumplings silky, perfectly folded parcels with just the right hint of umami. Siracha Chicken Dumplings, which packed a lively, lingering heat without overpowering the filling. The Chin Win Chicken was fragrant and well-seasoned, while the Crunchy Mushroom delivered an addictive bite that kept us reaching for more.

For mains, the Pan-fried Noodles were crisp yet delicate, soaking up the sauces beautifully. And to finish on a sweet note, the Tiramisu was indulgent but not heavy, with a balanced coffee kick.

Overall, Stir Fry combines quality ingredients with skillful execution. If you appreciate thoughtfully made Asian flavors with a modern touch, this place is well worth visiting.

featured_reviews.name: Darpan Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had booked an 11:30 pm slot through EazyDiner, but even after reaching earlier, the staff were in a tearing hurry to push through the final order — I shudder to think what would have happened had I actually arrived on time.

The Lemon Chicken Soup was bland and lifeless, the Artichoke Water Chestnut was dripping with oil, and the Edamame Truffle Dim Sum looked outright unappetising with a disturbingly artificial dirty-green hue, paired with an equally dubious-looking sauce. It’s baffling (and alarming) why such colours are being used at all.

Service was no better — they forgot our drinks, and only brought them after a reminder. To top it off, the staff dumped the main course on the table even while I was still struggling through the soup.

Overall, it was a deeply disappointing evening of bad food, rushed service, and zero finesse. Certainly not an experience I’d recommend or repeat.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Mr. Mehta,
Greetings!

Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed review of your experience with us. We are truly sorry to learn that your dinner did not meet expectations. Please accept our sincere apologies for the rushed service, delays in serving drinks and the lack of proper sequence in your meal. This is not the standard of hospitality we strive to deliver and we will be addressing this matter with our service team immediately.

We have also noted your feedback on the dishes. Regarding the dim sum, we would like to reassure you that we do not use artificial colours in any of our preparations. The colour you observed comes naturally from the ingredients used in the recipe, though we understand it may not have looked appealing. While food taste and presentation can sometimes differ based on individual preferences, our priority always remains on quality, freshness and safety.

Your comments on the soup, starters and overall dining experience have been shared with our culinary team for review and corrective action. Constructive feedback like yours is extremely valuable as it helps us identify gaps and improve.

If you are comfortable, we would very much appreciate the opportunity to speak with you personally and assure you that your concerns are being taken seriously.

We truly regret that your evening with us was disappointing and we hope you will allow us another opportunity in the future to provide you with the quality experience we are known for.

Warm regards,
Nilesh Raorane
Group General Manager

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Rastogi
featured_reviews.review_text: Decent food. Good crispy chicken with crispy spinach. Chicken satay was good but The rice had too Masala. Very outdoor Chinese types. Biacoff cake was great!

Great experience of food, ambience, taste, but little noisy and seating arrangement is not at all good.... Like seating in agood court with fixed seats !!! is the biggest drawbacks.... However, food quality and taste were great 👍👍 another negative point is little overpriced as compared with the food portions !!! Service was great 👍 valet parking is the only option

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this restaurant recently on our trip to Mumbai.

I visited after a very long time and was not disappointed! The food is delicious; the best Chinese food in Mumbai by far! The ambience is wonderful and the service, superb!

They went out of their way to make our special occasion, really special.

Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Julie Tankard
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a fantastic dinner at this restaurant last night. Our waiter Jagadeesh suggested some choices off the menu which were excellent. One of which was the lobster which was a generous portion and tasted amazing. Jagadeesh really looked after us and was both professional and friendly. I would definitely recommend this restaurant as it ticks all the boxes!

featured_reviews.name: A P
featured_reviews.review_text: Authentic Chinese food. Atmosphere and service is top notch. Highly recommend. Good vegetarian choice and very impressed with decor

featured_reviews.name: Pratik Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text: My visit at Golden Dragon, Mumbai was wonderful. A special thanks to Mr. Tushar — he is truly a genius and such a valuable gem for his team. His support and hospitality made my experience even better. Also, the Dumplings was absolutely awesome! Highly recommend this place.

featured_reviews.name: Bansi Pobari
featured_reviews.review_text: The staff behavior is totally unacceptable.  Even a layman knows what kinda of behavior is acceptable . Customer expects an experience to be memorable , not only in food but  also the service too. We had planned something for dessert and went to gave a chance over here. But the staff totally made us feel disappointed. The behavior amogst them , made us think that this is not the right place to have it.What is the use of such high profile service promise, if you can't have basic human behavior , forget about hospitality . So please don't give it a try at all. Your hard earned money will be wasted , and most important the behavior of staff would make the whole experience of Taj worst.

featured_reviews.name: Nicholas Holden
featured_reviews.review_text: This food was amazing. We had the duck experience which was worth the hour long wait. I’d definitely recommend calling ahead to order it though. The spicy short ribs and the maple ice cream were everything. Also the coconut water with lime was so sweet. Jesus, everything was delicious and the staff was so kind to accept a walk in 1hr before closing and still giving great service. Golden dragon was truly GOLDEN !

featured_reviews.name: Sumeet Chopra
featured_reviews.review_text:
A lovely relaxed lunch at the Golden Dragon !
The service team lead by Rachit was excellent ! Personal attention to detail and great service !
Food quality and taste was superlative. Though we were only 4 of us dining, we ended up ordering generously and actually polished off everything !
Again, I must say that the entire experience gets enhanced a few notches with great service !

featured_reviews.name: TJ
featured_reviews.review_text: We ordered asparagus and corn dumplings which were phenomenal! You can see the chef making them right in front of you, like a magician! The spring rolls were crispy, crunchy, had just the right amount of filling and the sweet chilli sauce was something I could eat a bucket of! The vegetarian fried rice with a non spicy black pepper sauce was the cherry on top :)

featured_reviews.name: Siddharth Kirtane
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a fantastic dining experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious—every dish was full of flavor and clearly made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. From appetizers to dessert, everything was perfectly cooked and well-seasoned. The presentation was beautiful, and the portion sizes were generous. If you appreciate great taste and attention to detail in every bite, this is definitely a place worth visiting. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Nitin Malhotra
featured_reviews.review_text: Food was good. Interiors are good too. Quantity was cool. One key issue i found was the outside had a bad smell. The area was very quiet. Cooling at the Resturant could have been maintained.

featured_reviews.name: Amol M
featured_reviews.review_text:
A spacious restaurant where one can enjoy good Chinese cuisine. Serves quite a variety of dishes one can choose from. The Squid is delicious! One can have a Prawn Fried Rice along with it.
Have been there in the afternoons most of the time. Courteous service and quick to the table orders.
Found it a bit spicy but enjoyed the taste.
Servings are sumptuous and the above two dishes made a good meal for two heavy eaters. Recommend you order not more than two dishes even if you wish to try a broad variety of food.

featured_reviews.name: Vaibhav Bhosale
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is located near Sassoon dock at a walkable distance. This place was suggested by one of the friend living in that area. The food was good and staff were helpful in ordering with the food . Service too was quick and it was not a rush time. So overall nice place to visit

featured_reviews.name: jasleen wadhwa
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a cozy place ahead of sasoon dock. Amazing vibrant interiors and good ambience. Its a family place so you will be super comfy with your family there. They have a vast menu serving authentic Chinese. The servers are calm and polite. I started with soup, ordering hot and sour chicken soup and veg manchow soup which tasted great. For appetizers we had hot dragon chicken, it was nice and tasted good. For the mains burnt garlic fried rice and chicken in basil sauce was ordered which was good but tasted similar to hot dragon. They have some good beverages and desserts too. Overall i would rate it a 6/10 as for me the MSG level was a bit high in the food. Do go try this place if you are around

featured_reviews.name: Akhil Maheswaran
featured_reviews.review_text: If you are Chinese food lover then it will be the best in this area. Rather than Chinese all other food items listed in the menu also give a signature of their own taste. The best part of this restaurant is the service giving you by the each and every staff there, even in the peak time they always try to attend you individually still you complete the food. Best destination for family or group visit/party in quite and ambient place for fooding. In peak times there is little waiting is required but they attend you gracefully. Parking also available.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Thorat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good food. Great quantity for the price. For under 600 per person, we were struggling to finish the food because it was too much.
I'd recommend the bamboo rice if you want some muted flavours

featured_reviews.name: Umama Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Loved the food. This is one of my favorite Chinese spots. The prawns we ordered were moderate in size and very tasty. The squid was also amazing. The seafood did not have a seafood stench as it was fresh. Ambience is also of the soothing type with comfy chairs and sofa. Good for a date night as well as outing with friends. Must note, the quantity of the food is a little less.
